main_body: A vending machine (magenta cabinet) with a grey-blue sloped top/hood, a pink band below it, a dark window with three shelves of items, and a dark dispensing slot at the bottom, all drawn flat from the front.
top_band: Rows 1-5 are a grey-blue hood (L 118-148), but it reads as a front-facing panel with a dark slot in it. Rows 6-7 are a pink strip with a dark line. There is no distinct horizontal top surface above the magenta front face.
evidence: The column at x=8 goes from a grey-blue hood (rows 1-5) to a pink line (row 6) and then the magenta front face (rows 8-30). The hood has a dark horizontal slot and a vertical front look, so it is a front panel, not a horizontal top surface. The window, shelves and slot are all vertical faces. The pink row 6 is a 1-row edge and is not a top surface. The whole piece is a front elevation with a decorative hat on top.

style.evidence: The candidate carries 22 colours per tile against 17 and 20 for the references, with 0% flat-fill coverage and 0% neutral dark edge pixels. The magenta body has 4-5 tones (#861a76, #5e1252, #3a0c34 and the near-black slot), the hood has 4 blue-grey steps, and the window shows items in several colours. The outline is a tinted dark purple, not neutral black. Texture is limited to shelf items and a few dark rows and the magenta body is fairly plain, but it is not shallower than the references on the measured facts.
